421: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਈਐ; ਕਰਣੀ ਭੀ ਸਾਈ ॥
Whatever work God sets a person to, to that same work he is set.
ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ. ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
God Himself creates and Himself cares for it, and this is His own greatness; to whom else can one cry? ॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ. ਸੋ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Only that person does the service the Guru teaches whom God Himself moves to do it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
O Nanak, one who hands his head to the Guru is set free and receives honour in the Lord's presence. ॥8॥18॥
O Master, You are beautiful and You are wise; through the Guru's beautiful word You are reached.
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
By great fortune the true Guru is met, and the state free of desire is attained. ॥1॥
ਮੈ ਓਲੑਗੀਆ ਓਲੑਗੀ; ਹਮ ਛੋਰੂ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
O Lord, I am the servant of Your servants; I am Your humble servant.
ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ; ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Let me live as You will; place Your Name in my mouth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਘਣੀ; ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
By His will a deep longing for His sight arises, and by His will He becomes dear to the mind.
ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਭਾਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
All honours are in my Master's hands; by His will a person receives honour at His door. ॥2॥
ਸਾਚਉ. ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Do not think of the eternal Lord as far away; He Himself dwells within each one.
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ; ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Wherever I look, He is pervading there; yet no one can put a price on Him. ॥3॥
ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰੇ; ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
God Himself builds and Himself pulls down, and He Himself beholds this power of His.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ; ਇਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Turning to the Guru, one beholds Him, and so comes to know His worth. ॥4॥
ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
One who does the work the Guru teaches gains the profit of the Name in this very life.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
But the true Guru is found only when the imprint of good deeds from the past is within. ॥5॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੋਟਾ ਨਿਤ ਹੈ; ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
Those who follow their own minds suffer constant loss of virtue; led astray by Maya, they keep wandering.
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਈ; ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
One who follows his own mind is blinded and does not remember God; how can he have His sight? ॥6॥
ਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Count a person truly born into the world only if he fixes his attention on the eternal Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭਏ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
Those who meet the Guru become the philosopher's stone, and their light stays merged in God's light. ॥7॥
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੋ; ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Whoever does the work given from the start remains detached day and night.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, those joined to the Name live content, dyed in the Lord's feet. ॥8॥19॥
ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
However much one may describe His virtues, I cannot know their end.
ਮੈ ਨਿਧਰਿਆ, ਧਰ ਏਕ ਤੂੰ; ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
O Lord, I am without support, and You alone are my support; You are my mighty strength. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
This is Nanak's prayer: that I stay at peace, joined to the eternal Lord's Name.
ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who loses his selfhood gains this understanding, and through the Guru's word is united with God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the pride of "I am great" is cast out, the understanding to pray at His door is found.
ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
When the mind is won over to the Master, He gives His eternal Name as its support. ॥2॥
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਸੇਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ ॥
One who day and night lives content in the Name: the eternal Lord accepts this service of his.
ਤਾ ਕਉ. ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ; ਚਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
No obstacle stands in the way of one who walks in the command of the Lord of the will. ॥3॥
ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ; ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥
Whoever walks in the command of the Lord of the will is placed, like a true coin, in His treasury,
ਖੋਟੇ. ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ; ਰਲੇ ਜੂਠਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
while the counterfeit find no place there and stay mixed among the false. ॥4॥
ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ. ਖਰਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ; ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Each day keep the pure Lord in your heart; so the eternal merchandise is bought.
ਖੋਟੇ. ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ; ਲੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
The counterfeit do not come into His sight; they are cast into the fire to burn away their alloy. ॥5॥
Those who have examined their own spiritual life recognise God Himself.
ਏਕੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ; ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
They see that the One Lord is the tree that gives the fruit of spiritual life, and His fruit is nectar. ॥6॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
Those who have tasted the life-giving fruit of the Name stay sated, joined to the eternal Lord.
ਤਿੰਨਾ. ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
They have no wandering and no distance from God; their tongue is steeped in the Lord's savour. ॥7॥
ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ; ਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
By God's command and the bond of your own deeds you have come; walk always in His will.
ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੈ; ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
May the virtue of the eternal Lord's remembrance be given to Nanak, who has no virtue; this I count the highest honour. ॥8॥20॥
ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ; ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
One whose mind is dyed in the Lord's Name sings the praises of the eternal One.
ਲੋਕਾ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਇ; ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
O Lord, when someone becomes dear to You, what do people lose by it? ॥1॥
422: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣ; ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
As long as there is life and breath in the body, the eternal Lord should be remembered.
ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ; ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who remembers Him, singing the Lord's virtues, gains the profit of spiritual bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਰ; ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੂੰ ॥
O merciful Lord, grant me Your work of devotion; it is without flaw.
ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ; ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨॥
As I praise You, my spiritual life grows; You are my prop and my support. ॥2॥
ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੁ; ਦਰਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
O Lord, You know the pain of the one who becomes a servant at Your door and keeps to it.
The world is amazed that You take away the pain of the one who worships You. ॥3॥
One who turns to the Guru understands that in the Lord's court and presence only His Name is accepted.
The life-time of one who recognises the Guru's word is fruitful and accepted. ॥4॥
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ, ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ; ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
Those who make virtue, contentment and love of God their provision for the road and repeat the Lord's Name,
ਮਨਹੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ; ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੫॥
and cast the vices out of their minds, are given the eternal Name by the eternal Lord. ॥5॥
If someone has the eternal love of the eternal Lord, the eternal Lord Himself has given it.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ; ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
He Himself does justice, deciding who receives love; what pleases Him is justice. ॥6॥
ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ॥
O eternal Lord, grant me the gift of Your Name, a gift that lasts for ever; He is merciful.
ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
I serve Him day and night, whose Name is priceless. ॥7॥
ਤੂੰ ਉਤਮੁ. ਹਉ ਨੀਚੁ; ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਆ ॥
You are exalted and I am lowly, yet I am called Your servant.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ; ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਂਢੀਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
O Nanak, pray: Lord, look on me with grace, so that I, cut off from You, may find Your eternal Name. ॥8॥21॥
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ. ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ; ਕਿਉ. ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Without the Name, how can coming and going end? How can there be union with God?
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ; ਨਿਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੋਈ ॥੧॥
The pain of birth and death stays heavy, and fear gnaws at the soul each day through duality. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕਿਆ ਜੀਵਨਾ; ਫਿਟੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
What is life without the Name? Such cleverness deserves only scorn,
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੁ. ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if one has not served the holy true Guru and has not loved devotion to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Coming and going ends only when the perfect Guru is found.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ, ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਇ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
The Guru gives the capital of the wealth of the Lord's Name, and the wandering after false Maya ends. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ. ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ; ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥
One who, in the Guru's refuge, joins the holy people and, giving thanks again and again, sings His praise,
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
finds the Lord, the root of the world, all-pervading and infinite. ॥3॥
This world is a show staged like a juggler's play,
ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ; ਉਝਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
in which life lasts a moment or an instant, and it takes no time to be laid waste. ॥4॥
People play the game of pride with the dice of falsehood and arrogance,
ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਾਰੈ, ਸੋ ਜਿਣੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
and so the whole world loses; only he wins who holds the Guru's word in his thoughts. ॥5॥
ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਹਥਿ ਟੋਹਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
As a blind man holds a stick in his hand, so the Lord's Name is all we have to show the way.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ, ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਨਿਸਿ ਦਉਤ, ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੬॥
The Lord's Name is a support that becomes dawn's light in the night of ignorance. ॥6॥
ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
O Lord, with the support of the Name, I stay in whatever state You keep me.
ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
Those who have found this companion who stays to the end find the door of release from Maya. ॥7॥
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿਆ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
By repeating the Lord's Name, the pain of the round of birth and death is wiped out.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
O Nanak, those who do not forget the Name, the perfect Guru carries across the world-ocean. ॥8॥22॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
O Lord, the pool of Your Name is my Shastras, Vedas and Smritis, and absorption in Your feet is my bathing in the Ganges.
ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ, ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਵੈ; ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
You made Maya of the three branches and are Master of this whole wondrous world; my mind delights in You, the root. ॥1॥
ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪੈ, ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Servant Nanak meditates on His feet and utters the life-giving word of His praise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
The three hundred and thirty million gods are Your servants, and You are the support of wealth, powers and breath.
423: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ. ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
His countless forms cannot be described; what can I say to express them? ॥2॥
ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ, ਜੁਗ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਚਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
O Lord, the three qualities in this world are of Your making, and the four sources of creation are Yours.
ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Only when Your grace comes is the highest state reached, and only then can one speak of Your indescribable being. ॥3॥
ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ. ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
O Lord, You are the Creator and all is made by You; without Your command what can any being do?
ਜਾ ਕਉ. ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ; ਸਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
The soul-bride on whom You cast Your gaze of grace stays absorbed in Your eternal Name. ॥4॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ. ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਜੇਤੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
O Lord, all who are caught in coming and going repeat Your Name in their own way,
ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ; ਹੋਰ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੫॥
but only when it pleases You does one turned to the Guru understand; the rest, following their own minds, wander in folly. ॥5॥
ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ; ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
God gave the four Vedas to Brahma, and he kept reading them over and reflecting on them alone.
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ; ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
The poor one did not understand that obeying God's command is the true way, and stayed caught in thoughts of hell and heaven. ॥6॥
ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੀਏ; ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥
God created the great men of each age, and people go on praising them as His incarnations.
ਤਿਨ ਭੀ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Even they did not find the end of His virtues; what can I say to describe them? ॥7॥
ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ, ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਦੇਹਿ ਤ, ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
O Lord, You are eternal and all You have made is the form of Your eternal being; if You give it, I can utter Your eternal Name.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਅਪਣਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੩॥
The one to whom You grant understanding of Your eternal Name rests in stillness of mind and is absorbed in the Name. ॥8॥1॥23॥
The true Guru has ended my wandering,
and has set the Name of the pure Lord in my mind.
Recognising the Guru's word, I now enjoy lasting spiritual bliss. ॥1॥
Listen, my mind, to this truth about God:
ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲਾ. ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Giver knows every way, and the treasure of the Name is found through the Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
This is the blessing of meeting the true Guru,
that the fire of attachment and craving within me has been put out,
and now, absorbed in stillness of mind, I sing the Lord's praises. ॥2॥
ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ; ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Without the perfect Guru, no one knows this truth,
for a person stays caught in attachment to Maya and in greed for other things.
Through the Guru the Name is found, and the worth of the Lord's word is known. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਤਪਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
The service the Guru teaches is the highest of all austerities,
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
by which all pains are removed and the Lord comes to dwell in the mind,
and one appears honoured at the door of the eternal Lord. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the service the Guru teaches, understanding of the Lord who pervades the three worlds is gained,
and, examining his own spiritual life, a person finds the Lord.
Through the word of the eternal Lord's praise, he gains a place at God's feet. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Through the service the Guru teaches, a person saves all his families from vices,
keeps the pure Name enshrined in his heart,
and gains lasting glory at the door of the eternal Lord. ॥6॥
ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Fortunate are those whom the Guru has joined to the Lord's service,
for in their hearts he makes devotion and remembrance of the eternal Name firm, day and night.
Through the Name all their families are saved from vices too. ॥7॥
Nanak tells you this unchanging truth:
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
keep the Lord's Name enshrined in your heart.
Those dyed in devotion to the Lord find the door of release from the vices. ॥8॥2॥24॥
Everyone in the world goes on building hope upon hope.
One who understands God's will comes out of the net of hopes.
Countless people lie asleep in the net of hopes, in the sleep of attachment.
He alone awakes whom God Himself awakens. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
The true Guru has taught the Name; without the Name, the hunger for Maya does not go.
424: ਨਾਮੇ. ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only through the Name is the fire of craving put out, and the Name is received by the will of the Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In this world, keep singing God's praises and stay acquainted with the Guru's word.
This devotion alone removes pride from the mind,
and by doing the service the true Guru teaches, one is accepted in God's presence.
ਜਿਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੀਤੀ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Form a deep bond with the One who created hope in the mind. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ; ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
What offering should be made to the Guru who recites his word to us,
and in his kindness sets the Name in our minds?
Offer him this head and cast out selfhood.
One who does so understands God's will and enjoys lasting bliss. ॥3॥
God Himself does all, and Himself has it done by beings.
He Himself sets His Name in the heart through the Guru.
He Himself leads astray and Himself puts on the right path.
The one He puts on the path, joined to the word of the eternal Lord's praise, stays absorbed in the eternal One. ॥4॥
The word of the eternal Lord's praise is itself the true utterance,
which in every age people have recited through the Guru.
But one who follows his own mind stayed caught in attachment and, wandering after Maya, went astray.
Cut off from the Name, the whole crazed world keeps wandering. ॥5॥
Through all three worlds, Maya alone holds sway.
ਮੂਰਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ; ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
The fool, reading and reading, has only made his love of Maya firmer.
He performs many religious rites and brings nothing but pain on himself.
Only by doing the service the true Guru teaches does one enjoy lasting bliss. ॥6॥
The Guru's word is sweet nectar; reflecting on it
and casting out pride, a person can taste the life-giving savour of the Name day and night.
So, by the Guru's grace, one enjoys bliss in stillness of mind.
Those dyed in the Name stay always in love of the Lord, absorbed in the eternal One. ॥7॥
Holding the Guru's word in your thoughts, recite and repeat the Lord's Name.
Casting out pride, read the Lord's Name alone.
Repeat the Lord's Name in awe of Him, steeped in love of the eternal One.
O Nanak, through the Guru's teaching keep the Name enshrined in your heart. ॥8॥3॥25॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
Asa Kafi · Ashtpadis · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 8
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
From the Guru comes inner peace; it is he who puts out the fire of craving.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
From the Guru the Name is received, and with it great honour. ॥1॥
O my brother, remember the One Name.
ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ; ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Seeing the world burning in vices, I have run to the Guru's refuge. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਮਹਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
From the Guru comes understanding of spiritual life, and the highest reflection on the supreme reality.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
From the Guru God's dwelling is found, and the stores of devotion are filled. ॥2॥
Through the Guru the Name is remembered and this reflection is understood.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Through the Guru come devotion and praise, and the word of the infinite Lord's praise dwells in the heart. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਦੁਖੁ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Through the Guru bliss wells up within, and no pain can touch one.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
Through the Guru pride is killed and the mind becomes pure. ॥4॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
When the true Guru is met, selfhood is gone, and one understands that God pervades the three worlds.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
His pure light shines everywhere, and one's attention is joined to that light. ॥5॥
ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ. ਸਮਝਾਇਆ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
When the perfect Guru explains, the understanding becomes exalted,
ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
the heart stays cool and at peace, and through the Name comes bliss. ॥6॥
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਾਂ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
But the perfect true Guru is met only when God casts His gaze of grace,
ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
and then all sins and misdeeds are cut away, and no pain or obstacle comes again. ॥7॥
425: ਆਪਣੈ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
All greatness lies in God's own hands; He Himself gives honour and joins a person to His Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ, ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੬॥
O Nanak, the one in whose mind the treasure of the Name comes to dwell gains honour. ॥8॥4॥26॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ, ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂੰ; ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Listen, my mind, keep the Name lodged within you; then, my brother, He Himself comes to meet you.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ, ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Worship God at every moment, for this alone is lasting, and keep your mind fixed on the eternal Lord. ॥1॥
ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ. ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
My brother, remember the one God's Name and you will find comfort;
ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ; ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
drive out pride and love of Maya from within, and you will receive great honour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨੋ. ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਪਾਈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Even gods and sages long for this devotion, but without the true Guru's refuge it is not obtained.
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਿਕੀ; ਤਿਨ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Pandits read their scriptures and astrologers their books, yet they too gain no understanding of devotion. ॥2॥
ਆਪੈ ਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
But God has kept all this in His own hands, and nothing can be said of whom He gives it to;
ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ. ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
the Guru has made this clear: we receive only what He Himself gives. ॥3॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
All beings and creatures are made by Him, and He alone is the master of all;
ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
so whom can we call bad? Only if someone other than Him dwelt in them. ॥4॥
ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਏਕਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
The one God's command runs through the world, and each must do the work God has written on his head.
ਆਪਿ ਭਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Those whom He Himself set spinning in attachment to Maya are gripped within by greed and other vices. ॥5॥
ਇਕ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ; ਬੂਝਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Some He Himself has made Gurmukhs, and they come to grasp the way of true spiritual life.
ਭਗਤਿ ਭੀ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
On them He also bestows His devotion, and their hearts fill with the treasure of the Name. ॥6॥
ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Those with true spiritual insight see the eternal Lord everywhere; this is the understanding that comes to them.
ਓਇ ਭੁਲਾਏ. ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ, ਨ ਭੁਲਨੑੀ; ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੭॥
If anyone tries to lead them astray, they are not misled; they know the eternal Lord alone dwells everywhere. ॥7॥
ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ; ਪੰਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
The five vices dwell in the hearts of these wise ones too, but the five themselves grow wise and keep within bounds.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ, ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ; ਨਾਮਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੭॥
O Nanak, without the true Guru these five are not brought under control; pride is overcome only through the Name. ॥8॥5॥27॥
ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਸਭੁ ਵਥੁ ਹੈ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
The whole treasure of the Name is within the heart; searching outside in forests yields nothing.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
It is found by the Guru's grace, and then the doors within, shut by attachment to Maya, open. ॥1॥
Brother, God is found through the true Guru alone;
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the treasure of the Name is within everyone, but it is the perfect true Guru who shows it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਲਏ; ਪਾਏ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Whoever becomes a buyer of God's Name receives the precious reflection on spiritual life;
ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੈ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ; ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
his heart opens, and with inner sight he sees the stores of the Name that free one from attachment to Maya. ॥2॥
ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਹਿ; ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
Within a person are countless treasures of the Name, and the soul too dwells within;
ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
by the Guru's grace one gains the fruit the mind longs for, and the round of birth and death is over. ॥3॥
ਪਾਰਖੀਆ. ਵਥੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਲਈ; ਗੁਰ. ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Those who test spiritual life, given understanding by the Guru, have guarded the treasure of the Name in their hearts.
ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
The Name is a priceless treasure that a person finds only by taking the Guru's refuge. ॥4॥
ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ, ਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਹੈ; ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
What can one find by searching outside, brother? The treasure lies within the heart.
ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੫॥
Misled by error, the whole world wanders searching, and so one who follows his own mind loses his honour. ॥5॥
ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਛੋਡੇ ਆਪਣਾ; ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
As a cheat leaves his own home and goes to another's house for wealth,
ਚੋਰੈ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਪਕੜੀਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
and is caught like a thief, so without the Name a person suffers blows. ॥6॥
ਜਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
Those who have truly understood their own heart, brother, live in comfort;
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
they have recognised God dwelling within, and this is the true Guru's grace. ॥7॥
ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ. ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
God Himself gives the gift of the Name, and no one else; He Himself grants understanding of it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥੨੮॥
O Nanak, keep remembering the Name, and so win glory at the eternal Lord's door. ॥8॥6॥28॥
426: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਸਾਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Tasting the Name, a person begins of himself to examine his spiritual life, brother, and its taste turns sweet.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਚਾਖਿਐ. ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Those who taste God's essence and come to love the eternal Lord are freed from attachment to Maya. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
God is utterly pure, and He can dwell only in a pure mind.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If we praise Him by the Guru's teaching, we stay detached from Maya while living in it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ; ਸਭ ਅੰਧੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Without the Guru's word one cannot examine one's own spiritual life; the whole world stays blind, brother.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru's teaching the Name gives light within the heart, and at the end the Name alone is a companion. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਰਤਦੇ; ਨਾਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
Those who repeat the Name do the world's work while absorbed in it, and the Name stays fixed in their hearts.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
The Name is within them and on their lips; through the Guru's word they reflect on the Name alone. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
One should listen to the Name and set the mind on it; through the Name comes honour.
ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਨਾਮੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Whoever praises God for ever and ever finds a place at His feet through the Name. ॥4॥
ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Through the Name alone light arises within the heart, and through the Name glory is won.
ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥
Through the Name alone spiritual joy is born, and one stays in God's refuge. ॥5॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Without the Name no one is respected in God's court; one who follows his own mind loses his honour there.
ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੬॥
Such people are bound and beaten in Death's city, and waste their human birth in vain. ॥6॥
ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
All the world serves the one who repeats the Name, and the Guru gives the understanding of the Name.
ਨਾਮਹੁ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
Only one who repeats the Name is respected everywhere, and through the Name comes honour. ॥7॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
But the Name comes only to one to whom God Himself gives it, setting him on the Guru's teaching and granting understanding of the Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ. ਕੋ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੯॥
O Nanak, every honour is in the Name's power; only a rare one gains the Name by great good fortune. ॥8॥7॥29॥
ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ. ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ; ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ. ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
The ill-fated soul-brides cannot find the Husband-Lord's dwelling, nor do they know the joy of union with Him.
ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ. ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ; ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
They speak harshly and do not bow, and love of Maya is the whole love of their lives. ॥1॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
How can this mind be brought under control?
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਠਾਕੀਐ; ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace it is held back, and through the wisdom he gives it comes to rest within. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਓਨੁ; ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
The fortunate ones God Himself has made beautiful in life, giving them His love.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਦੀਆ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
They live by the Guru's will, and resting in stillness of mind within the Name is their adornment. ॥2॥
ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
They keep their Husband-Lord ever in their hearts, and through love their heart becomes a lasting bed for Him;
ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮੋਹੀਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
meeting the Beloved, they gain spiritual joy and stay absorbed in His love. ॥3॥
ਗਿਆਨ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
The soul-bride whose adornment is spiritual wisdom holds a boundless treasure and wins glory;
ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ; ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ. ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੪॥
through love for her Husband-Lord she grows beautiful in life and becomes the chief queen. ॥4॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ. ਰੰਗੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਸਚੈ ਅਲਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
The eternal, unseen, infinite Lord has Himself kept His love within the fortunate soul-brides;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੫॥
they do the service the Guru teaches and stay steeped in love for the eternal Lord. ॥5॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ; ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
The fortunate ones have made the Lord's virtues their ornament and wear them as a necklace round their neck.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰਮਲੁ. ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਣਾ; ਅੰਤਰਿ. ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
They rub the fragrance of His love on their bodies and keep within the jewel of reflection on His virtues. ॥6॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸੇ ਊਤਮਾ; ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Those dyed in devotion are of high caste; high caste and family come only through the Guru's word.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
Without the Name all the world is low caste, sunk in vice like a worm in filth. ॥7॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਦੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਹਉ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
All the world goes about puffed up with pride, and without the Guru's word this pride does not go.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ. ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ; ਸਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੮॥੩੦॥
O Nanak, those dyed in the Name are rid of pride and stay absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥8॥8॥30॥
ਸਚੇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Those dyed in the eternal Lord become pure in life, and their glory lasts for ever;
ਐਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਪਦੇ; ਆਗੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
in this world they are known in every home, and hereafter their glory shines for all time. ॥1॥
427: ਏ ਮਨ. ਰੂੜੑੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ; ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
O my beautiful, colourful mind, dye yourself in the lasting colour of the Name.
ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ. ਜੇ ਰਪੈ; ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ, ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If the mind is dyed with the beautiful word of praise, this colour never fades or leaves. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮੈਲੇ. ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Caught in vices through love of Maya, we become low, filthy in conduct and full of pride.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਏ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
Meeting the Guru, the philosopher's stone, we turn to gold, and the pure light of the infinite Lord shines within us. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰੰਗੀਐ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
Without the Guru no one can be dyed; the colour takes only when the Guru is met.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ. ਜੋ ਰਤੇ; ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥
Those dyed through awe of the Guru and love for him are absorbed in the eternal Lord through His praise. ॥3॥
ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ. ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without awe the mordant does not take, and the mind does not become clean.
ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ. ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ; ਝੂਠੇ. ਠਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥
Without awe, even religious deeds leave one false, and the false find no place with the Lord. ॥4॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ. ਸੁ ਰਪਸੀ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Only the one whom God Himself dyes, bringing him into the company of the holy, will be dyed.
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
The company of the holy comes through the perfect Guru, and one who finds it rests in stillness of mind, in the eternal Lord and His love. ॥5॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ. ਸਭਿ ਐਸੇ ਰਹਹਿ; ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
Without the holy company all go about like beasts and cattle;
ਜਿਨੑਿ ਕੀਤੇ. ਤਿਸੈ, ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭਿ ਚੋਰ ॥੬॥
they do not know the One who made them, and without His Name all are thieves. ॥6॥
ਇਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ, ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਹਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Some, resting in stillness and love through the Guru, buy virtues, and their faults are sold off.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ; ਵੁਠਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੭॥
Through the service the Guru teaches they gain the Name, and God comes to dwell within them. ॥7॥
ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
The one God is the giver to all, and He Himself sets each one to his work.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਸਬਦੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੯॥੩੧॥
O Nanak, He Himself has made lives beautiful by joining them to His Name, and united them with Himself through the Guru's word. ॥8॥9॥31॥
ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚਦੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
All the world longs for the Name, but only one on whom God has mercy obtains it.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ. ਜਿਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥
Without the Name there is nothing but suffering; comfort is only for the one in whose mind God plants His Name. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
O Lord, You are infinite and the source of mercy; I have come to Your refuge.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your Name is found from the perfect Guru, and through Your Name comes honour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
He alone dwells within each one and throughout the world; He has created this world of many kinds.
ਹੁਕਮੇ. ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ; ਦੂਜਾ. ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
By His command He has all work done; brother, who else can be named with such power? ॥2॥
ਬੁਝਣਾ ਅਬੁਝਣਾ, ਤੁਧੁ ਕੀਆ; ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
O Lord, understanding and lack of understanding are Your play, and on each head is the work You have ordained.
ਇਕਨੑਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਇਕਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੩॥
Some You forgive and unite with Yourself; others, false and wrapped in Maya, are thrust out of Your presence. ॥3॥
ਇਕਿ. ਧੁਰਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਹਿ; ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
O Lord, some You have made pure in life from the start and joined to Your Name;
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
from the service the Guru teaches they gain spiritual joy, and through the eternal word he gives them understanding. ॥4॥
ਇਕਿ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ, ਵਿਖਲੀ ਪਤੇ; ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
Some are crushed, filthy and wicked, whom God Himself has kept away from His Name;
ਨਾ ਓਨ ਸਿਧਿ. ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ, ਨ ਸੰਜਮੀ; ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਤਵਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
they have won no success, learned no good sense, kept no good discipline, and wander about unsteady. ॥5॥
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
The one on whom God casts His glance of grace He fills with faith in His Name,
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮੀ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੬॥
and lets him hear the pure word, by which he comes to a discipline of service and contentment. ॥6॥
ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜਿ. ਨ ਪਹੂਚੀਐ; ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
By reckoning one cannot reach the end of His virtues, nor exhaust them by telling them over.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
His worth is learned from the Guru, who joins one to the eternal word and grants understanding. ॥7॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸੋਧਿ ਤੂੰ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Search this mind and body of yours, and reflect through the Guru's word.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ, ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਪਾਈਐ. ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ, ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੩੨॥
O Nanak, the treasure of the Name lies within this body; it is found through the Guru's boundless grace. ॥8॥10॥32॥
ਸਚਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿਨਾ. ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
The fortunate brides who made their lives beautiful through the Guru's word are dyed in the eternal Lord;
428: ਘਰ ਹੀ. ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
reflecting through the eternal word of praise, they found the Husband-Lord within their own heart. ॥1॥
ਅਵਗਣ. ਗੁਣੀ ਬਖਸਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
The soul-bride who fixed her attention on God had her faults forgiven through virtues;
ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
she has won God as her Husband, for the Guru has united her with Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਕਿ. ਪਿਰੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Some, misled by wandering after Maya, do not know their Husband to be close at hand;
ਕਿਉ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
how can such ill-fated ones meet Him? Their night of life passes in pain. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ. ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ; ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Those in whose minds the eternal Lord dwells, through doing the eternal work of His praise,
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਸਹਜ ਸਿਉ; ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
serve Him at every moment in stillness of mind, absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥3॥
ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਆ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
The ill-fated, misled by wandering, speak empty words and eat the poison of attachment to Maya;
ਪਿਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੇਜ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
they never come close to their own Lord, their heart's bed stays empty, and they suffer. ॥4॥
ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
The eternal Master is One alone; take care, my mind, not to stray through wandering.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ. ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
If you serve Him by the Guru's teaching, you will lodge the eternal, pure Lord in your mind. ॥5॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
The fortunate bride, casting pride out from within, meets the eternal Husband-Lord;
ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ. ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀ; ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
she stays joined to her Husband's feet at every moment, her heart's bed grows steady, and she enjoys spiritual joy. ॥6॥
ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ; ਪਲੈ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Those who left the world saying "mine, mine" gained nothing in their hands.
ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੭॥
The ill-fated bride finds no place at God's feet and departs at last wringing her hands. ॥7॥
ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
O soul-bride, that eternal Husband is One alone; keep your attention fixed on that One.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੩੩॥
O Nanak, say: O soul-bride, if you want comfort, keep God's Name lodged in your mind. ॥8॥11॥33॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ. ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚਖਾਇਓਨੁ; ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Those to whom God Himself gave the life-giving water of the Name to taste found its savour, resting in stillness and love,
ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ. ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
and saw that the eternal Lord is free of need and has not a trace of greed. ॥1॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
The eternal, life-giving water of the Name rains everywhere, but it falls into the mouths of those who turn to the Guru.
ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Singing God's virtues in stillness of mind, their mind stays ever in bloom. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
Brides who follow their own minds remain ever ill-fated; even standing at God's door they wail.
ਜਿਨੑਾ. ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਦੁ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Those who never tasted union with the Husband keep doing the deeds written on their foreheads from the start by their past actions. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਜੇ. ਸਚੁ ਜਮੈ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
One who turns to the Guru sows the eternal Name in his heart and it grows there; the eternal Name becomes his trade.
ਜੋ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਹੈ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੩॥
Those whom God has set to this profitable work He gives the treasures of His devotion. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
Brides who turn to the Guru are ever fortunate; living in His awe, they make their lives beautiful through devotion,
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
enjoy union with their Husband at every moment, and keep the eternal Name fixed in their hearts. ॥4॥
ਜਿਨੑਾ. ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ. ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those who have always enjoyed union with their Husband;
ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
they cast out selfhood from within and stay ever joined to His feet. ॥5॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ. ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Those in love with the Husband have mind and heart cooled, and their faces shine.
ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
Killing pride and craving within, their heart's bed becomes pleasant, and the Husband abides there. ॥6॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
The soul-bride into whose heart God comes in mercy, through the Guru's boundless grace,
ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
that fortunate one meets the Husband who alone is like Himself. ॥7॥
ਸਭੇ ਗੁਨਹ. ਬਖਸਾਇ ਲਇਓਨੁ; ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
The Lord, able to unite, has forgiven all her sins and united her with Himself.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੩੪॥
O Nanak, speak only words of His praise, hearing which He may love us. ॥8॥12॥34॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਗੁਣ ਊਪਜੈ; ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Virtues come from the true Guru when God unites one with that Guru;
429: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
then one remembers the Name in stillness of mind, and understanding of spiritual life shines forth within. ॥1॥
ਏ ਮਨ. ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ; ਸਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
O mind, never think that God is far away; see Him always close at hand.
ਸਦ ਸੁਣਦਾ. ਸਦ ਵੇਖਦਾ; ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He ever hears and ever sees all, and through the Guru's word He will be seen pervading everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਤਿਨੑੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Those who turn to the Guru keep examining their own spiritual life and remember Him with attention fixed.
ਸਦਾ ਰਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
They ever enjoy union with their Husband and find spiritual joy in the eternal Name. ॥2॥
ਏ ਮਨ. ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
O mind, apart from God no one is truly yours; reflect through the Guru's word and see.
ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ; ਪਾਇਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
Run to God's refuge, and you will find the door of release from Maya's bonds. ॥3॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ. ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ; ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Through the Guru's word the Name is heard and the right way understood, and one stays attuned to the eternal Lord;
ਸਬਦੇ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
through the word pride is killed, and one enjoys bliss at the eternal Lord's feet. ॥4॥
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ. ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੋਭ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
In this world glory comes through the Name; glory without the Name is no true glory.
ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ. ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ; ਜਾਦੀ. ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
This glory won through Maya lasts only four days and is gone in no time. ॥5॥
ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Those who forgot the Name have brought spiritual death on themselves and stay spiritually dead;
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
they never tasted the essence of God's Name and stay absorbed in the filth of vice like worms in dung. ॥6॥
ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
Some God Himself has forgiven and united with Himself, joining them to His Name at every moment;
ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
they practise the eternal Name, dwell in it, and stay absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥7॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ; ਜਗੁ ਬੋਲਾ. ਅੰਨੑਾ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
Without the Guru's word the Name is not heard nor God seen; the world, deaf and blind in attachment to Maya, wanders astray.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
Without the Name it suffers pain, and the Name is found only by His will. ॥8॥
ਜਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Those who have fixed their minds on the Guru's word become pure in life and are accepted in God's presence.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੯॥੧੩॥੩੫॥
O Nanak, they never forget the Name, and they are known at the eternal Lord's door. ॥9॥13॥35॥
ਸਬਦੌ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਪਦੇ; ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the Guru's word devotees become known, and God's praise becomes their everyday speech.
ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ. ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Selfhood leaves them, their mind accepts the Name, and they are united with the eternal Lord. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
God's Name is the honour of His devotees;
ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਨੑ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
their life becomes fruitful, and everyone respects them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ; ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Self-centredness and "mine" set a person apart from God, and from this arise great anger and arrogance.
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਇ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
When this dies through the Guru's word, the separateness ends, the attention merges in God's light, and God is met. ॥2॥
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
When we meet the perfect true Guru, our life becomes fruitful;
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਭਰੇ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
we receive the Name, the nine treasures, and our stores are filled, never to run short. ॥3॥
ਆਵਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Only those traders in this capital come to the Guru who love the Name.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Whoever turns to the Guru obtains this wealth, and the Guru's word and reflection on God's virtues dwell within such people. ॥4॥
ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
But those who follow their own minds grow arrogant and do not know the worth of devotion;
ਧੁਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ; ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
God Himself has led them astray from the start, and they lose life's game like a gambler. ॥5॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ. ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Without love devotion cannot be done, and the body finds no spiritual joy.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਿ ॥੬॥
The gift of love is found from the Guru, and through the devotion he teaches the mind comes to peace. ॥6॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ. ਸੋ ਕਰੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Only the one whom God Himself moves to devotion can practise it, reflecting on the Guru's word;
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
then self-centredness and the sense of mine and yours die within, and the one Name dwells in the heart. ॥7॥
ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ. ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
For devotees the one Name is their caste and family; God Himself makes their lives beautiful.
ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
They stay ever in His refuge, and as it pleases Him He brings each task of theirs to completion. ॥8॥
430: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਅਲਾਹ ਦੀ; ਜਾਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Through reflecting on the Guru's word one comes to see that devotion to God brings a wondrous blessing.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ; ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥੧੪॥੩੬॥
O Nanak, one in whose heart the Name dwells is kept by devotion in awe of God, joined to the Name, and his life is made beautiful. ॥9॥14॥36॥
ਅਨ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਲਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ. ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
Caught in the tastes of other things, a person goes astray, and missing the Name he suffers pain;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਜਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
he does not meet the great Guru who gives the understanding to praise the eternal Lord. ॥1॥
ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ. ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
O my crazed mind, taste the elixir of God's Name and take its relish.
ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੂੰ ਫਿਰਹਿ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Caught in the tastes of other things you wander about, wasting your life in vain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
In this world only those who stay in the Guru's refuge are pure; they keep their attention on the eternal Lord, absorbed in His Name.
ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ. ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ. ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
But what can be said? Without God's grace nothing is obtained. ॥2॥
ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ; ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Those so blessed examine their own life, and through the Guru's word drive the vices from the mind and grow detached from other tastes.
ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ; ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
They stay in the Guru's refuge, and the forgiving Lord forgives them. ॥3॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Without the Name peace is not found, and the pain within does not go;
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
but this world stays caught in love of Maya, and wandering after Maya it goes astray. ॥4॥
ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ. ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
The discarded brides do not value union with their Husband, and adorn their bodies in vain;
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲਦੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ; ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਨ. ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
night and day they go about burning within, and the Husband never comes to their bed. ॥5॥
ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
The fortunate soul-brides drive out self-conceit from within and find a place at the Lord's feet;
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ; ਅਪਣੇ ਸਹਿ ਲਈਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
through the Guru's word they make their lives beautiful, and the Lord has united them with Himself. ॥6॥
ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Love of Maya is pitch darkness, and in it people put death out of their minds.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ. ਭੀ ਮਰਹਿ; ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
Those who follow their own mind die a spiritual death, stay in the round of birth and death, and are disgraced at Death's door. ॥7॥
ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੇ ਮਿਲੇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Those whom God Himself joined to His feet reflected on His virtues through the Guru's word and merged in Him.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ, ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੩੭॥
O Nanak, those who dwell in the Name stand with faces bright in the court of the eternal Lord. ॥8॥22॥15॥37॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Through spiritual knowledge a person won over the five, truth, contentment, compassion, faith and patience, and turned away the five, lust and the rest;
he settled the five in his body-town and drove the five, lust and the rest, out of it. ॥1॥
ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
In this way, O my brother, his body-town came to be inhabited,
ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ; ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and sin left him when the Guru firmly gave him the understanding of spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ; ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
The Guru set round it a fence of daily remembrance of the eternal Lord,
and holding that knowledge in his thoughts he made his gates, the senses, secure. ॥2॥
O my friends and brothers, you too sow the Name in the field of the body,
take the Guru's refuge, and keep trading in remembrance of the Name. ॥3॥
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ; ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
All their shops, the senses, become shops of peace, stillness of mind and spiritual joy,
those traders who become one with the Guru, their banker. ॥4॥
ਜੇਜੀਆ ਡੰਨੁ; ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ. ਜਗਾਤਿ ॥
No vice can levy poll tax, fine or toll on their trade in the Name,
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ; ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਪ ॥੫॥
for the true Guru has given them the seal of pardon approved at God's door. ॥5॥
You too, in the Guru's refuge, load the goods of the Name and carry on your trade,
earn the profit, and through the Guru find a home at the Lord's feet. ॥6॥
The true Guru is the banker, and the Sikhs are the traders who draw from him;
the Name is their capital, and they keep the eternal Lord in their hearts; that is their account. ॥7॥
ਸੋ ਵਸੈ ਇਤੁ ਘਰਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵ ॥
The Lord dwells in this heart-home to which the perfect Guru gives the gift of devotional service,
and which becomes a town for God that never wavers, O Nanak. ॥8॥1॥
